text:
pagerduty: [P1] Auth-Service | token validation error rate spike -> page fired for service: auth-service (errors > 5% for 5m)
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert created: PD-AB12. Notifying on-call.
sara (oncall): acked via PagerDuty :white_check_mark: I'm on it, digging into logs now. anyone else online?
tony (sre): I'm up, looking at ingress metrics. seeing a big jump in 401s from the public API gateway.
nina (support): support dashboard shows a handful of customer errors: several mobile clients 401ing, approximate 15% failed logins in last 10m.
jamie (prod-sec): thx. any changes to the signing keys or rotation in the last hour?
tony (sre): quick grep of deploys -> nothing in auth cluster. but jwks fetch latency spiked. trying to fetch JWKS now.
tony (sre): ```
curl -s https://jwks.prod.redwood.example/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'
# returning kids: ["k2023a","k2024b"]
```
tony (sre): token samples show kid=k2022x in incoming tokens; that's not present in JWKS -> signature verify failing.
sara (oncall): so tokens still signed with old key (k2022x) but JWKS rotated away. looks like propagation/rollback issue.
jamie (prod-sec): confirmed. key-rotation ran ~07:32UTC and jwks endpoint updated but some signing instances didn't pick up previous key or didn't publish old kid. possible key publish race.
nina (support): customers affected: acct:acme-corp, acct:fastchat reported incidents. Ticket #12345 created.
incident-bot: escalated to sec-lead per PD escalation policy (2nd level) due to bed-impact.
sara (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) re-enable acceptance of legacy kid on validators; 2) force a reload on signing instances to include prior key material; 3) push temporary fallback signing config if needed. doing step 1 now.
ton y (sre): I'm toggling validator feature flag to accept fallback public key cache for 30m: `auth.validator.accept_legacy_kid=true`
jamie (prod-sec): heads up, accepting legacy keys increases risk window but reduces customer impact. good for short term while we verify key stores.
sara (oncall): applied flag to canary -> 401 rate dropped from 15% -> 2% in canary. rolling to rest.
nina (support): customer update drafted: "We're seeing intermittent token validation errors; engineering is applying a short-term fix and we'll update when rotation is stable." sending to affected customers.
tony (sre): running key-sync job now across signing fleet: `kubectl -n auth exec deploy/key-rotator -- /bin/keysync --ensure old:k2022x`
tony (sre): sync complete on 5/6 signing pods, last one failing with OOM; restarting that pod.
sara (oncall): restart triggered, pod came up with both keys present. JWKS now lists k2022x and k2024b.
jamie (prod-sec): double-checking audit logs: rotation sequence looks normal, but one bootstrapping step failed on a node due to an env var mismatch (KEYS_INITIAL_LOAD=false). following up with infra.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: PD-AB12 acknowledged by sara. Escalation cleared.
sara (oncall): monitoring 30m window. currently auth error rate stable ~1.2% (background). continuing to observe.
nina (support): customers notified. we'll keep tickets open until SLA window passes.
jamie (prod-sec): post-mortem items: make key-rotation idempotent, add a preflight check for JWKS completeness, and surface any NODE env var mismatches to deploy pipeline.
tony (sre): creating follow-up runbook PR for `auth.key_rotation` with explicit rollback path and auto-fallback to previous jwks when token failures detected.
sara (oncall): handing off to tony for overnight watch. I'm off shift in 45m. Handoff notes:
- mitigation: legacy acceptance flag enabled (will auto-revert in 30m)
- signing fleet: all pods show both keys (k2022x, k2024b)
- customer impact: reduced to background errors, affected accounts notified
- follow-ups: jamie to own post-mortem, tony to own runbook PR

Please ping if error rate climbs >3%.
tony (sre): taking over. I have console access and pagerduty on my phone. thanks @sara.
incident-bot: Handoff recorded. Oncall owner set to tony (sre).
sara (oncall): leaving thread. good job team :thumbsup:
pagerduty: PD-AB12 status: Resolved (mitigation applied). Close when post-mortem starts.
